summary: The two-stage workflow exposed proposition-level gaps, but Audit over-classified KG content, missed two target structures, and produced two Patch contract failures. Mandatory regression gates did not pass.

primary_results.result: 2 of 4 target issue classes detected cleanly
primary_results.details: CH02-S04 qualifier loss was detected; CH12-S04 CDD qualifier/result was detected among excessive candidates. CH06-S10 calculation-to-classification and CH47-S04 action-references-experience were missed.
CH06-S10 violated REFERENCES endpoint constraints; CH12-S04 returned an incomplete/truncated patch after Audit generated 16 gaps.
CH03-S02 incorrectly converted investigative obstruction into a P7C card; CH05-S04 and CH12-S04 contained substantial KG-only over-classification.

regressions.baseline: No card; ordinary investigative difficulty handled by KG
regressions.variant: Added a PRODUCES card for authorities being hindered by corrupt officials
Classified five general obligations or control effects as missing P7C claims

issues.baseline: Existing result edges omitted appeared/suggested qualifiers
issues.variant: Audit marked both edges partially covered and proposed qualified alternatives
Audit focused on threshold-setting instead and Patch failed the endpoint contract
Audit found the CDD issue but also generated 15 additional gaps, leading to an invalid patch response

issues.baseline: Scenario-setting REFERENCES historical experience remained missing
issues.variant: Audit again classified the relation as KG-only

next_action: Create a new experiment that changes only the Audit eligibility gate: require an AML/CFT operational action or judgment linked to an input, condition, standard, or independent result; exclude general control effects and risk mechanisms; explicitly retain worked classification examples and action-based-on-input open relations.
